title: Implement and converge full relativistic Pauli-blocked weak-form 2→2 collision moments
objective: Complete a gauge-qualified χ1–SM thermal collision operator with 2->2 invariant phase-space measure, both initial/final Fermi statistics and independent convergence. The existing Yukawa decay, electron transport and nonrelativistic drag are baselines; none is a justified gamma_el for the relativistic BEST parent M/T=0.1.
prerequisites: Read AGENTS.md, GOAL.md, STATE.json, EVIDENCE.md, BACKLOG.md and full kinetics/MICROPHYSICS-MODEL.md
Check current PR #1 HEAD and latest Scientific verification CI including 44932655044; fix regressions before more physics
Check actual primary Yin 2023/Sakurai-Yin 2025 and external pinned BEST conventions
steps: Choose explicitly UV/gauge-valid portal and quantify necessary e, neutrino, muon and number-changing channels in early thermal plasma; justify approximation domain

Derive Lorentz-invariant 2->2 source C_chi(p) with four phase-space measures and momentum delta plus |M|^2; both Pauli directions and e chemical potential; derive matching SM Q and source for each independent charge

Numerically integrate moving-particle differential collisions using t+CM azimuth or invariant phase-space variables, which retain final-state e and chi Pauli; validate physical phase space by exact 4-momentum conservation
Demonstrate C_chi[fFD(T_SM,mu_chi)] = 0 in equilibrium at matching T; number conservation, Pauli, total dark+SM energy, entropy positivity and sign of Q away from equilibrium
Benchmark collision energy/momentum moments against earlier independently validated rest exact Pauli Q, moving no-block energy moment, heavy NR eta and exact on-shell event gain/loss
Derive controlled Fokker-Planck approximation if exact collision integration too costly; quantify failure at relativistic M/T ~ 0.1 instead of using heavy eta there

Run mesh/angular/MC/time independent convergence tests and save compact measured data; replace phenomenological gamma_el in coupled BEST+SM only once kinetic rate/kernel is validated and BE/FD collision ledger correct
After each evidenced stage checkpoint/commit/push and immediately select next bottleneck: thermal masses, variable gstar, long freezeout or observed Omega depending results
acceptance: No final-state Pauli omission in relativistic collision operator; exact common-T detailed balance and independently measured error
Conserves chi number under elastic contact; Q_dark+Q_SM=0 and positive/Pauli bounds with finite numerical tolerance
Momentum-dependent collision kernel or validated reduced FP operator with explicit domain and error budget
Actual comparison to physical micro tree-level source, not substituted ad hoc gamma or unblocked frequency
Physical 86 eV/CLASS and BEC claims remain false until final cosmological criteria
deliverables: tested source and independent quadrature/thermal scan
updated checkpoints and immediate next action
fallback: If full integral computationally intractable: derive controlled hard-momentum and soft-transfer bounds and verify a collision subspace numerically
If 1↔2+portal EFT invalid at T: replace with documented renormalizable UV theory and rederive all rates
If GitHub CI/tool access blocked: preserve checkpoint and independent analytic tests; do not claim continued background execution
external_action_policy: GitHub public research branch and compact Actions permitted. No force-push/merge. Computer Use or any user's Windows PC only after explicit approval.
